classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins with specific enzymatic activities and analyze their biochemical properties.
assumptions: The provided GO terms are sufficient to retrieve relevant UniProt sequences without needing additional organism or length filters.
Sequence analysis will be performed on the raw FASTA sequences retrieved by the retrieval node.
